## Editorial checklist

- [ ] Compiles with `latexmk -pdf` without errors
- [ ] Section order follows `docs/EDITORIAL_GUIDE.md`
- [ ] Intuition given before formalism
- [ ] Every theorem has a complete proof (no "clearly", "obviously", "easy to see")
- [ ] Every proof read line by line by a human
- [ ] Every numerical example recomputed independently
- [ ] Every new term indexed with `\term{...}`
- [ ] All `\cref` references and citations resolve
- [ ] Notation matches `template/style/docmath-macros.sty`
- [ ] Doctoral problems carry a verified source (university, speciality, year)
      or are marked *classical, source to be verified*
- [ ] No package loaded or environment redefined inside a chapter file
